name: RA_TERMS_LINES_DISCOUNTS_
description: The RA_TERMS_LINES_DISCOUNTS table stores discount information for each row in the RA_TERMS_LINES table. Each payment term line can have multiple discount rows in this table. . The primary key for this table is TERMS_LINES_DISCOUNT_ID.
